name: Dart logging 1.3.0 — Aivexus closed-vocabulary logging adapter
description: Real public dart-lang/core logging source with a typed, closed-vocabulary Aivexus adapter. New version awaiting Linux CI and independent security review.

provenance.adapter_source: Aivexus adapter separately developed alongside preserved upstream package

security.notes: Closed event vocabulary reduces raw input risk; independently reviewed production authorization still absent.

integration.adapter_notes: New v0.1.1 API requires AivexusEventCode enum, not caller-supplied event code strings; local Dart logging remains detached, bounded and offline.
known_constraints: New v0.1.1 source has not yet passed Linux CI. Do not treat it as tested until verified results are source-bound.
Only enum values declared in source can be emitted, but privacy, license and dependency review remain necessary.
No Flutter/Android or other host runtime tests have been performed.
Original public dart-lang/core 1.3.0 package preserved byte-for-byte; adapter separately maintained.
Production certification requires independent signed source/adapter, license and SBOM approval.
